content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Attendee Registration Component ## slug: attendee-registration-lightning-component-agent-experience ## seoTitle: Attendee Registration Component ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End We have brought the power of {{variable.Object_Event}} registration into Salesforce with our brand new {{variable.Component_RegistrLightningComp}} Lightning component. If you need to register someone directly in Salesforce, you no longer need to navigate through 5+ records. Before you had to navigate to the specific {{variable.Object_Event}}, add new {{variable.Object_Attendee}}, relate a {{variable.Object_Contact}}, create an {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, and finally link the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Object_EventItem}} (Ticket) to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. Now, you just need to use our {{variable.Component_RegistrLightningComp}} component to register an Attendee. Need to cancel an {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s registration? You can do that simply with the {{variable.Component_RegistrLightningComp}} component too! Did we mention the registration component works for paid and free {{variable.Object_Event}}s?! ![Attendee Registration Lightning Component](https://youtu.be/cncVyu2FCg4){height="480" width="640"} ## Updated Functionality The Add Attendee component's permission management has been updated. {{variable.Object_Campaign}} and {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} object access is no longer a prerequisite to use the component. The following functionality now applies. * Users who have read permissions to one or more of the {{variable.Object_Account}}, {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, and {{variable.Object_Report}} objects can search the object(s) and add {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s. * Users with access to the {{variable.Object_Account}}, {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, and {{variable.Object_Report}} objects will see {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records from these objects. * Users will only see {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records from the {{variable.Object_Account}}, {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, and/or {{variable.Object_Report}} objects they can access. * Users who don’t have access to the {{variable.Object_Account}}, {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, and/or {{variable.Object_Report}} objects will not see any {{variable.Object_Attendee}} suggestions as they cannot retrieve records related to those objects. * If a user who doesn’t have access to the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} object tries to load an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} who has already been added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} from the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} object, the user will see the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}, but they will not be able to see any {{variable.Object_Campaign}}-specific information they don’t have access to. ## Set Up the Component ### Update the Page Layout The {{variable.Component_RegistrLightningComp}} component can be added to the {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, {{variable.Object_Attendee}}, and {{variable.Object_Event}} lightning pages. 1. Navigate to one of the supported object records. 2. Click {{variable.Button_Setup}}. 3. Click **Edit Page**. 4. Scroll down to the Custom – Managed section and drag and drop the BT Events Attendee Registration component on the page. 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![Setting up the component](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Setting%20up%20the%20component.png){height="" width=""} ### Activate Geocodes 1. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}}. 2. Click {{variable.Button_Setup}}. 3. In the Quick Find box, search for and click “Data Integration Rules”. 4. Click "Geocodes for Contact Mailing Address." ![Activate%20Geocode%20Attendee%20Reg%20Comp](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Activate%20Geocode%20Attendee%20Reg%20Comp.png){height="" width=""} 6. Click **Activate**. 7. If you agree with the message, click **Ok**. 8. Perform a hard refresh on the Contact record. The {{variable.Field_AttdRegComp_SortByDistan}} checkbox will be enabled automatically on the {{variable.Object_Contact}} page of the {{variable.Component_RegistrLightningComp}} component. ![Sort%20By%20Distance%20Checkbox](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Sort%20By%20Distance%20Checkbox.png){height="" width=""} **Note:** If required, repeat the steps above to activate the {{variable.Object_Lead}} and {{variable.Object_Account}}. ## Register an Attendee from the Event Record After you add the {{variable.Component_RegistrLightningComp}} component to an {{variable.Object_Event}} record, you will see all the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s populate within the component. ![registering an attendee 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/registering%20an%20attendee%201.png){height="" width=""} :::(Info) (New Filter on the {{variable.Component_RegistrLightningComp}} Component) The new filter, called “Distance” is based upon the Contact's mailing address and the Event venue's physical address. To use the new feature, check the {{variable.Field_AttdRegComp_SortByDistan}} checkbox on the Search screen. The results will be sorted by the Event Start Date/Time or Distance. If the contact mailing address is null, the checkbox will be disabled, and the help text will display this message: “The Contact’s Mailing Address is not populated. Please exit this window, update the Contact’s mailing address, save, and reload this screen.” If physical location is not populated for the Event Venue, results will still appear, but the message “Venue Location Missing” will be shown. ::: After selecting an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} you'll be able to add an {{variable.Object_Attendee}}! ![registering an attendee 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/registering%20an%20attendee%202.png){height="" width=""} From here, you can either click {{variable.Button_Submit}} to register the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}, or add a second {{variable.Object_Attendee}} by clicking **Add New Attendee**. ![registering an attendee 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/registering%20an%20attendee%203.png){height="" width=""} Ta-da! Your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has been created! ![registering an attendee 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/registering%20an%20attendee%204.png){height="" width=""} If you have a paid {{variable.Object_Event}}, you will be prompted with the "Payment" tab. If you click {{variable.Button_ProceedToPayment}} on this page, it will redirect you to the associated {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. ![registering an attendee 5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/registering%20an%20attendee%205.png){height="" width=""} After opening the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, you can then forward the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DocumentLink}} URL to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to be paid. Once paid, the {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_PaymentStatus}} field will be updated from {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Unpaid}} to {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Paid}} and the {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_Status}} field will update from {{variable.Picklist_InvoiceStat_ReadyBill}} to {{variable.Picklist_InvoiceStat_Completed}}. There is also a {{variable.Field_Attendee_NotPaid}} checkbox field on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object. Any time the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is marked as {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Unpaid}} this checkbox will be checked. This gives the user who is registering the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s the ability to easily view if the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has paid or not. ![registering an attendee 6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/registering%20an%20attendee%206.png){height="" width=""} ## Cancel an Attendee Once a {{variable.Object_Contact}} or {{variable.Object_Lead}} has registered for an {{variable.Object_Event}}, the {{variable.Object_Event}} will populate in the component. ![cancelling an attendee 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/cancelling%20an%20attendee%201.png){height="" width=""} Next, click the icon below, it will cancel the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} from the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ![cancelling an attendee 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/cancelling%20an%20attendee%202.png){height="" width=""} The {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will be updated to {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Canceled}}. It's as simple as that! Quick and easy way to remove a single {{variable.Object_Attendee}} from an {{variable.Object_Event}}.
